title: Objective: Understand how AI changes the way product and R&D operate and how to create a competitive advantage at your company
drivers_heading: WHY AI CHANGES THE OPERATING MODEL
driver_1_title: Speed changes the unit of work
driver_1_body: Drafting, coding, testing, and prototyping move faster—enabling teams to work in smaller, testable slices.
driver_2_body: Unclear customer evidence, product intent, and acceptance criteria propagate through delivery just as quickly.
driver_3_title: The Product–R&D interface becomes the advantage
driver_3_body: Shared evidence, feasibility checks, human review, and governance turn isolated AI gains into repeatable team performance.
outcome_1_title: How to frame the right opportunity
outcome_1_body: Product and R&D select a valuable, feasible, full-stack problem.
outcome_2_title: Turn customer evidence into executable intent
outcome_2_body: Synthesize signals into scores, epics, stories, criteria, and testable assumptions.
outcome_3_title: Understand how coding agents change the SDLC
outcome_3_body: Extend planning and coding through review, testing, CI/CD, SRE, and human oversight.
outcome_4_body: Review evidence, challenge ambiguity, agree on a demonstrable slice, and prepare work for agents.
outcome_5_body: Run engineering and prototyping in parallel, then converge through rapid, evidence-driven iteration.
outcome_6_body: Address adoption, output quality, reuse, architecture, testing, measurement, and governance.
